title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Ferrari Purosangue
description:
Ferrari closed the order book on its first four-door car before it had delivered a single one. The Ferrari Purosangue has no anti-roll bars at all. And its chief executive asked the world not to call it an SUV. These are two of the things you may not know about the Ferrari Purosangue: how its suspension works, and why Ferrari stopped taking orders. Everything here is sourced. We read Wikipedia, Motor1, Robb Report, Carscoops, autoevolution, Autocar, Autoblog and a Czech business site that analysed Ferrari's results. Ferrari's own performance figures are claims, and we mark them as claims. Prices conflict between sources, and we show every one. And our own arithmetic is always labelled as ours.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
